edge.title: Retune aux AdamW (lrs up, wd 0.001) and Muon (lr 0.025, wd 0.05)
edge.summary: A hyperparameter-only retune of #12 that became the official train_gpt_simple.py baseline. Aux AdamW learning rates rise (embed 0.3→0.7, LM head 1/320→0.004, 1-D 0.01→0.015) and gain decoupled wd=0.001, while Muon takes a smaller lr with stronger decay (lr 0.035→0.025, wd 0.025→0.05; lr·wd 8.75e-4→1.25e-3 per step at peak). The run is scheduled for 3250 steps and read at the final step (no early stop), 75 steps fewer than #12.

changes.label: Aux AdamW lrs raised
changes.detail: optimizer1 groups: embed.weight lr 0.3 → 0.7, LM head proj.weight 1/320 → 0.004, ndim<2 params 0.01 → 0.015; betas (0.8, 0.95) and eps 1e-10 unchanged.

changes.label: Aux AdamW wd 0 → 0.001
changes.detail: weight_decay=0.001 now applies to every aux group (embedding, LM head, RMSNorm gains and biases) as decoupled p *= 1 − lr·0.001, e.g. 7e-4 per step on the embedding at peak; gains decay toward 0, not 1.

changes.label: Muon lr 0.035→0.025, wd 0.025→0.05
changes.detail: optimizer2 = Muon(lr=0.025, weight_decay=0.05): smaller steps with stronger shrinkage (lr·wd 1.25e-3 per step at peak).

changes.label: Steps 3350/3325 → 3250/3250
changes.detail: train_steps=3250 and the claim is at the final step, so #12's 25-step early stop is dropped.

edge.parent_check: Consistent: the diff vs #12 is hyperparameters only. The script is byte-identical to the current records/track_3_optimization/train_gpt_simple.py (git 452cc39, 'Tune train_gpt_simple baseline hyperparameters'), the README quickstart baseline.

AdamW embed 0.7 / head 0.004 / 1-D 0.015, wd 0.001, betas (0.8,0.95), eps 1e-10

hparams.init.proj: zero (attn.proj, mlp.proj and LM head weights)
